title: Size sum over a cons list
statement: For a Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables and a finite list $cs$ of such circuits, the sum of the sizes in the list $c::cs$ equals $\mathrm{size}(c)$ plus the sum of the sizes in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
$cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables
